game.name: Halo Reach (Brazil)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt,Zh,Ko)
game.desc: Halo Reach on Xbox 360 tells the story of the fall of the planet Reach, before the very first episode of the famous FPS series. It follows the desperate fight of the Noble squad of powerful Spartans against the countless Covenant legions. The campaign is playable in 4 player co-op and the game features a multitude of highly configurable multiplayer modes, including the popular Baptism of Fire. A comprehensive map editor is also included.
